Default preprocessing keeps the footer that the aggressive preset drops

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
